author: Joshua Fluke
description:
Employee appreciation has officially gotten out of hand.

Apparently companies will do almost anything to make employees feel appreciated except give them more money, more PTO, a bonus, a promotion, an extra day off, or anything else that might materially improve their lives.

Instead, we get pizza parties, pickle-themed company picnics, carnival games, popcorn bars, toilet-paper competitions, clown costumes, keychains, iced coffee, balloons and enough LinkedIn photos to make sure everyone knows just how amazing the company culture supposedly is.

In this video, we're looking at some of the most ridiculous examples of corporate employee appreciation and employee recognition I've seen.

One company celebrates Employee Appreciation Week by wrapping grown adults in toilet paper and posting the pictures online. Another has employees putting on pickle masks and smashing pickle piñatas. title: EMPLOYEE APPRECIATION IS GETTING OUT OF HAND!
